blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Robert Cuyong Toledano Jr. landed among the October 2026 Certified Public Accountant Licensure Examination (CPALE) topnotchers, bringing pride to Cebu after securing eighth place nationwide. Toledano, a graduate of the University of San Jose-Recoletos (USJR), earned a rating of 90.50 percent, placing among the country’s highest-scoring examinees in the licensure examination. The Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) released the results on Tuesday, November 3, announcing the names of the successful examinees, topnotchers, and performance of schools in the October 2026 CPALE.
